firstShown.explanation: Maintain a clock and an oldest-to-newest recency list. Expired entries are removed before each event; advancing also removes entries expired at the new time. Valid puts remove the old key, evict oldest entries until the byte budget fits, then append the new entry.
firstShown.mapping: config.capacity maps to the byte budget; state.now is time; state.entries is recency order with key, value, size, and expiry. Event type selects put, get, or advance. Output reports the resulting value, keys, byte sum, and time.
firstShown.assumptions: State is trusted only as the state previously returned by this function. All supplied numeric values satisfy the stated safe-integer constraints. Expiry is inclusive: expiry<=now means expired.
firstShown.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var s=null;for(var i=0;i<output.length;i++){var r=solve({config:input.config,state:s,event:input.events[i]});if(JSON.stringify(r.output)!==JSON.stringify(output[i]))return false;s=r.state}return true}
firstShown.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config,e=x.event,s=x.state;if(!s)s={now:0,entries:[]};else{s={now:s.now,entries:s.entries.map(function(a){return{key:a.key,value:a.value,size:a.size,exp:a.exp}})}}function clean(){s.entries=s.entries.filter(function(a){return a.exp>s.now})}function idx(k){for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)if(s.entries[i].key===k)return i;return-1}function out(v){var b=0,k=[];for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++){b+=s.entries[i].size;k.push(s.entries[i].key)}return{state:s,output:{value:v,keys:k,bytes:b,now:s.now}}}clean();var t=e.type;if(t==='advance'){s.now+=e.dt;clean();return out(null)}if(t==='get'){var j=idx(e.key);if(j<0)return out(null);var a=s.entries.splice(j,1)[0];s.entries.push(a);return out(a.value)}if(t==='put'){if(e.size>c.capacity)return out(null);var j=idx(e.key);if(j>=0)s.entries.splice(j,1);if(e.ttl===0)return out(null);var b=0;for(var i=0;i<s.entries.length;i++)b+=s.entries[i].size;while(s.entries.length&&b+e.size>c.capacity)b-=s.entries.shift().size;s.entries.push({key:e.key,value:e.value,size:e.size,exp:s.now+e.ttl});return out(null)}return out(null)}
